title: Critique: the body causes experience but does not constitute it

statements.text: Ned Block holds the orthodox brainbound view: experience depends causally on the body and on sensorimotor activity, but a specific pattern of brain activity directly determines it, so a brain in a vat with the right neural pattern would have the same experience. Enactive views mistake causes of experience for its constitution.

sources.quote: Block contends that this view misidentifies what causes experience with what constitutes experience.
